nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Micropoint for Dark Spot Patches

avis.texte: I am a light to medium skinned person. These are kind of like a Band-Aid where there's a center (that goes on dark spot) and the adhesive part around it that actually sticks to your skin. The adhesive part actually created a light circle on my face, but did nothing for the actual dark spot. Weird and annoying!
I got this product because of a spot I had on my chin and it really worked! I left it on all day and noticed a difference that night.
Used an entire package of these to try and lighten a small dark spot under my eye. It did not help or change thr dadk spot at all. Save tour money.
I do like this product. It has helped my dark spots to fade some.

I had a dark spot for the past month, because when I get mirgaines I throw up and my pimples get dark so after a whole minth I decided to buy this and that same night after I took it off I could SEE the difference, by day two its literally GONE… amazing thank you, you got yourself a customer!!!

I had a dark spot for the past month, because when I get mirgaines I throw up and my pimples get dark so after a whole minth I decided to buy this and that same night after I took it off I could SEE the difference, by day two its literally GONE… amazing thank you, you got yourself a customer!!!

This profuct has been one tjat im thankfuk to hsve found especially for dark soots left in my face from previous acne. After constant use if the patches, all of my scars are now not very visible and im so thankful.

i only bought these because one of my pimples left behind a purple-ish dark scar on my face and i thought that surely 8 patches can clear this guy up right? wrong because tell me why these have done ABSOLUTELY NOTHING???? i was really disappointed and i will not ever be repurchasing.

Idk what or how the folks that are saying not to buy/ doesnt work use them, but i only apply at night on dry, clean skin. The next morning it will be much less viaible if not, fullu gone. I ise the hero cream in the purple bottle for a few days before using them. Will never stop.

avis.titre: They work and are worth it!
avis.texte: This brand is the o my brand that I love to use! I tried these for the first time and used it overnight. My dark spots from scarring was gone in the morning! Amazing product that actually works!
Still have the dark spot near my eye after using all of them per the instructions. Time for a laser treatment. Unless it's a mild dark spot, dark spit treatments need laser.
This is my second purchase and it really works!!!! I'm 70 years old and of course, I have age (yuck) spots. Works wonderful. You gotta get these.
this product doesnt work AT ALL, all you get are little pricks and no benefits at all 💀definitely will be trying a different product cause they didnt lighten my dark spots at all.

I have hyperpigmentation/ sun spots. Some spots are old and some are newer, but I have quite a few. It's not possible for me to lightening all of them at the same time, as you only get 8 patches. I am concentrating on the hardest ones to cover and I tell you, consistency is key. You can't use it every night, but twice a week. I put them on at night and sleep with them, which is about 7 hours of wear. I am treating 3 spots, one of which didn't get a 3rd patch. I see some improvement, especially the two I treated 3 times. I'm out and need to swing by Ulta to pick up more. Hopefully these spots disappear!

I typically dont wrte reviews for products, but this was deserved. I was struggling with a stubborn dark spot i had from picking my acne and after the second use of the patch, the whole dark spot literally rubbed off with no damage to the skin underneath. It literally rubbed off my face…10/10 get it!!
I love this stuff. if I'm consistent this works wonders and helps so much with my scarring

These patches are great for use a few days before a important date. Some dark spots faded almost completely overnight, but others understandably take more time to clear up. I purchase these every once in a while and its nice to have some on hand just in case!
Ineffective, I saw no changes while using these. It's expensive, you only get 8 in a pack. Buy a serum, this product sucks.

this stuff is great. I use it all the time for my acne scars and dark marks. wish there were bigger packs cause I buy like 3 at a time cause it's so good. between this and my retinol, my skin is skinning

avis.titre: Save your money and buy a serum.
avis.texte: I was excited to try these but realized you only get a few in a pack for the cost. The worst of all is how they dont seem to stick or stay on the skin. Yes; on dry, clean skin. Going to use the last couple patches that havent been wasted to see if theres any difference. Should have just bought a serum :(

I had a dark spot that I wanted to try this on and I put it on before bed. The next morning I woke up and took the patch off, and the whole area was bright red!! It was red and scarred, and looked like I had a large pimple the size of the patch, when I didn't. It certainly didnt look like that before! I kept expecting it to go away and but its been weeks and it has only gradually faded!! Theres still a ring of scarring around where the patch was. DO NOT BUY THEM

the patches definitely do work. it just takes time. i used them on two acne marks i have leftover and followed the instructions. they're not completely gone but they definitely have faded a bit. i've been recommended the lightning wand so hopefully that works!
Honestly wasn't sure if these were going to work but to my surprise after the first use i saw immediate differences. Complexion was much more even and spots faded.
I bought 2 packages because I was convinced they were going to work. Followed directions exactly and noticed no fading at all. Save your money and buy a good concealer.

These patches do work! I'm in my early 40's and have Asian genes. Any Asian knows that our skin is very sensitive and unfortunately we develop dark spots early and easily. I've tried many products but this one has really shown results! I could tell after two tries my spots were fading. The dark spots will never completely disappear. However they have faded enough that an acquaintance commented my skin looked more even. There are only two things I would change. One, they need to make them in larger sizes and two, there needs to be more patches in the box.
I have many acne scars and quite a bit of acne, they are expensive but they definitely made my acne scars smaller and a lighter color. If they were cheaper id buy them allllllll the time.
This product really works. The little patches help fade dark spots on my skin overnight. Perfect compliment to Hero's other treatment products.
These are the best dark spot treatment patches on the market.

I didn't expect the result my mom received when she tried these. She used one and a very dark spot and after a few hrs removed it and can I say it was very light almost gone. So she ended up my whole package for the rest of her dark spots.

avis.titre: Works but needs several uses to see change
avis.texte: Had to use it several times in one spot to see any results, but definitely reduced some pigmentation

I've tried everything, including laser treatment to get rid of my dark spot, under my eye. This is the only product that has shown fading, slowly but surely. I've had to use over 10 orders so far but at least it is working!
Don't see a noticeable difference, but keeps me from picking at my scars
Product is really effective but it rakes a few days of repeated treatments to see results
I cannot live without these. I wish there was more in a pack than only 6. I wish that they had different patch sizes too!
It works well, but you need to be patient. It is not a product that works overnight. It will take a few days to eliminate some of the dark spots.
I think by using only once my big blemish kind of started going down and then I started using rescue balm. Powerful duo :+1::skin-tone-2:
Works well but results aren't permanent - you need to keep applying them regularly.

I have so many dark spots from past pimples that I've picked at or left alone. This is the only product that I've seen significant results. The only thing is that it's taking more than 3 weeks for it to fully go away, still using this product because of that. However it's the only product that I've seen results!

Here's all ya need to know - it ACTUALLY works. I struggled with acne between the ages of 22 and 29. All of a sudden I was experiencing bad acne with the combination of dark spots. I'm not lying when I said I have tried so many products, so I didn't have much hope for this (hence my subject line) BUT because it's from Hero, I gave it a shot. Now, you do too.

Be careful if you have sensitive skin—the outer part of the patch has left a red circle on my face for two days now. I will say it helped to fade my dark spot in just one use, but not worth the reaction it gave me :') sucks because I've liked every other product from this brand

My dermatologist identified the 1/2 inch diameter red spot on my face as sun damage :( and I was about to ask that it be removed until I tried these patches on it. Over the past couple months the redness has noticeably faded and the spot is getting smaller and smoother. Can't wait to go for my skin check up next month and share this with the doctor. I am SOOO grateful for these. I use them once every 2-3 days as directed.

Worked better and faster then expected. I'm very fair and have some very dark spots on face and one on hand. Noticed significant lightening after two applications. And patches adhered well with no irritation. Highly recommend this product.
The small spikes in the patch are great because really get into the pore and clean it. I used them when I have a big mess of dark spots in a specific area of my face and body.

I really like these! When pimples flatten & there's still a darkish area left behind, you apply these to the area & all of the microdarts deliver Niacinamide, Vitamin C as well as Tranexamic Acid to help brighten and even skin tone. They also have Sodium Hyaluronate to help retain moisture so the area doesn't get super dry while trying to brighten the area. It takes a little longer for these to work versus the original pimple patches, but they really do work! I also love that they aren't packaged individually like some brands do with their patches. Hero produces less waste for me & is more convenient because each package has 6 patches. Other brands would wrap those 6 patches individually, creating a lot more mess, takes longer to apply them and then I have all this trash that I can't recycle. Im really loving my results that I've seen so far & hope they'll continue to fade & brighten dark spots once pimples are flat. My reason for 4/5 stars is the fact that you do only get 6 patches per package. For the $13 + shipping + tax that I've paid, I wish they'd include 12 patches for that much money.

I couldn't believe how fast it worked. It didn't remove the, totally but I've had the dark patches for a while and I just thought that was my life right now. But, nope, they lightened up significantly. I'll be buying more and watching the results.
I think it is great but I need many more in a package to make a difference!
They Work and I will be buying more. One night of wearing them made a difference.
Wow! Seems very effective, however, i have so many dark spots that i used them all up in 2 days. Will have to order more when I figure out how.
I have used 4 of the 6 micropoint for dark spots. The results are amazing, spots aren't completely gone yet, but are much less visible. Going to reorder right now.
Will update when I get to use for weeks. So far not abrasive or aggressive.
It helped lighten the pigmentation left after the pimples go away, however it's pricier than I would like considering how many patches I need to lighten specific spots to my liking.
Amazing! With one try, it really brings down redness on scarring! These products are incredible!
Amazing! With only one use, I noticed a difference in a couple of dark spots on my brow and chin. Love this brand! Will use all the products until the end of time :)
My dark spot is still there...didn't really do much in lightening it.

I've had stubborn upper lip melasma for about a year now -- which always become worse when I've been out in the sun. I've tried so many skin lightening creams, peels, and pills. I bought this on a whim and after one usage of all patches in the pack on my upper lip they seem to have been a real dent in my melasma after I thought nothing could. I just bought three packs more because I think I'll need a few rounds to hopefully get rid of my melasma. But I'm excited because it's the first affordable treatment that seems to have made a difference. Hero folks - I'd love if you'd make this in a larger patch that could cover a full upper lip (or I imagine some people may want their whole side of the cheek, etc.) - putting a bunch of the circles down doesn't really cover the whole thing and I imagine will need thoughtful placement as I continue to use them. But anyways, I'm happy -- I'm hopeful about my melasma erasure after continued use of this product.

These make lighter appearing dark spots improve in appearance after a couple uses. Darker dark spots will also need another therapy and more time to fade away. I use them on my back mostly. Overall I recommend giving these a try to see if it works for you.
I used all of the batches in the box. I wore them for about 1.5-2days straight - didn't see any visible changes over the week and a half I tried them out.

I use this not just on my face, but on parts of my neck and chest. The lightening power of this is fantastic!!! Over one night I already noticed a significant reduction in my particularly strong dark spots.
I'm honestly not sure how I feel yet. I'm almost out of them but I'm not seeing much of a change in the spot I've been treating. More to come..

Perfectly size for my single dark spot; instructions were very clear & slotting into my routine was easy. So happy with the effects as I can barely see the spot after three weeks of usage. I will definitely be ordering more for other spots!
I can notice a significant reduction in redness and inflammation post pimple. Makes my skin's recovery time much shorter compared to without the patch.
Love these so much, after having my son my dark spot has gotten worse and this little patch has started to help lighten it up! Will keep using these along with the mighty patch for blemishes!

I don't have tones of breakouts I'm 35 but I use sunscreen when I go running and sometimes if I don't wash my face right after my run I will get a blemish. I had one blemish and figured these patches would be a good spot solution. I left it on overnight and unfortunately it discolored my skin. I washed my face and the discoloration did not go away. It's been about two days and you can still see it. I will not be using these again. It did not state on the package this was a possibility. If you have ever had laser hair removal and had spot discoloration this is what it looks like. I consider myself olive tone, not sure if this product works for all skin tones or if you should not have sun exposure or what, but my skin is easily marked (by the sun with sun spots, etc) if you have sensitive skin, please don't buy. Also, the blemish spot did not change color just the skin around it where the patch covered....

avis.titre: Works great! Please make them more cost effective!
avis.texte: Product works great, but I wish more came in a pack like the blemish patches. I go through these so quickly, and would use them every night if there were more of them and it wasn't so expensive for so few in a box. I have post acne hyperpigmentation and going to sleep in these is great. Wake up in the morning and start to see a difference.
Works great! Some spots are a bit more stubborn than others but it does a great job lightening.

My skin must be sensitive to these because everywhere I put them, I ended up with a perfectly round red spot once removed that lasted about a day. Perhaps I need to keep them on for less time. That being said, I am still finding improvement using the other Hero products. I love them all!

When I used the Micropoint for Dark Spot patches, I could see a change after one use. For the spots that were darker, larger, or had been there longer it took a few more applications. The results seemed to produce a shrinking and then a fading, without any pain or burning, like some other products.

avis.titre: I think works, but too pricey to see!
avis.texte: I think they work, but it's hard to say since only 6 come in the package. I think they'd be good for longer-term, and if I could wear one every few days, they might do something for my dark spots. However, there's so few in the package, and the package is so expensive, I'll never get to see what the results are.
I have completed one pack of these Micropoint for dark spots and have yet to see a difference. For the price I expected a vast change given you only get 6 in a pack. I'm a bit let down tho.
The box is super cute. I used them every night for 6 days and added the mighty patch to my nose in my routine. The effects were great! They faded one really bad dark spot significantly!
It works if you use it for several days. U will see a difference.
The quantity in the package did not allow for any noticeable results to be seen. Followed all directions and frankly, saw no changes.

I have used this a couple times on some spots but haven't noticed any difference yet. The scars that have started are a bit sunken in so after using them they look temporarily level with the rest of my skin but that goes away after a day. I like to think for that reason that it may be helping some but maybe just too soon to tell. I haven't seen in difference in pigmentation fading yet.
I have to do this more in order to see the results of my scars and dark spots
I would like to think it helps but I really can't tell if its actually helping or not.
I have two acne marks that I am trying to fade with these patches. I think they are working but I do wish more patches came in a box.
I was amazed at how quickly this worked for me. A lot of my redness and scaring from acne have faded significantly after regular use of these patches. I will be buying more for sure!
Noticed a skin difference after 2-weeks. Dark spots have practically disappeared!!
Bought these for a dark spot. I used the whole pack and did notice the spot had lightened up. I would purchase again.

As someone with cystic acne, these are a staple for my skin when it's healing from a breakout and I'm left with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. I can see the difference after constant use. My dark spots are much lighter after a week or two. When I'm not using these patches I also use the lightning wand. Both are great for dark spots! I order hero cosmetic products about once a month and the shipping is always super fast!

The name of this product says it all. I absolutely love the micro needles that help stick to your skin and pull out all of the impurities. Put one on before bed and in the morning your pimple/spot is significantly smaller. This works great for dark spots as well. It left my spot soothed and moisturized. I will defiantly be keeping these on rotation in my house.
Really helpful when you have a pimple that's already popped and healing - helps to speed the process up a bit.
I had a bout of bad acne which left some terrible dark spots. These are the perfect size and easy to apply. I highly recommend.
I used a pack of these on one dark spot on my face. I used one every other night and saw no change. The other products are fantastic though!
This stuff is magic! I put it on a pretty large red spot and overnight it almost disappears. All the redness is gone and it is so much smaller
After using a pack of these, I didn't see much progress on a dark spot of my face. For the price I wish they were worked better.

I am currently using the Mighty Patches. I decided to take a leap of faith and use it on some dark spot blemishes that I have because unfortunately I have yet to see pictures and results of those with a darker complexion to see if it really works on African-American skin I do plan on buying more and I have had results with the pimple patches hopefully I will see results stay tuned.

I haven't really had acne scarring until recently, so these have been a life saver at minimizing my scars. Plus, it's a cool sensation to feel the teeny tiny needles on my skin. I pick these up when I can!
This has done wonders for my stubborn dark spots that nothing will fade! And for the price there it no reason not to try them! Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: I'm not sure if these work or not.
avis.texte: I tried these patches for the first time last week. Since the box only has six patches, I really didn't get a sense these work. I'm not saying these don't work, I think I would need to use them continuously for at least 3-4 days. I think if the box came with more than six patches this would be a great product.
Not a bad price point for what you get and these totally work! My dark spots clear up much faster with these patches and they really are life savers.
Good, but not worth the money. Didn't really see a difference
Can see a difference with just one use! This is easily my favorite product.
Seems to have faded my erythema a bit, i still have a couple more applications though. Good so far!

These are helpful with healing scars. The results are not immediate in my opinion, it does take a couple of them to work. They stay on so well though compared to other patches I've used. It's comfortable to keep on and the micropoints aren't painful.

This product did wonders for my skin! I compulsively pick at my skin, which results in countless acne scars and dark spots. After using the Micropoint for Dark Spots patches, my dark spots and scars are basically invisible. I have sensitive, acne prone skin, and I never had any irritation from this product whatsoever. If you feel discouraged because your dark spots won't go away, try this product. I used to feel like my dark spots would be on my face forever, but this product gave me visible results. I swear by it!
I'm not sure if I'm seeing any results at this point. There's not many patches for the price.

I bought this product to try it and OMG I fall in love of it. I noticed a change in the 3 day of using it, my skin is brighter and my acne scars faded away in a 80% on my 3rd week of use! I totally recommended!

Always notice a difference the morning after, but only in fresh dark spots. This works! I also pair with reacue cream. Photos are 3 weeks apart. Not seeing much of a difference after using them 3 times + brightening wand every day on really old dark spot from a year ago though, may need something penetrates deeper like actual microneedling for those!

This product is great for anyone who deals with hyperpigmentation or dark spots. It takes away the issues I have post acne. The only con I have with this is how it kinda slips off on the spot you have it on.
Love this patch! It's perfect for wearing on a no-makeup day when I'm under a mask! Once I take it off my pigmentation is noticeably lighter!
